mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, image_url, audio_url, latitude, longitude, radius, /* 动态计算当前位置到景点的距离（米） */ ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326)) AS distance FROM scenic_spots WHERE is_deleted = 0 /* 核心过滤：计算出的距离必须小于等于景点的感应半径 */ AND ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326)) <= GREATEST(radius, 150) ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, description, image_url, audio_url, latitude, longitude, radius, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scenic_spots WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, name, description, image_url, audio_url, latitude, longitude, radius, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scenic_spots WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN name = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, id DESC
